If a Pal Egg is left in it, it will automatically hatch after some time has passed. |workload = 50}} The '''Egg Incubator''' is a Structure in {{PW}}. == Acquisition == It's a tier 10 Ancient [[technology]] item and requires 1 ancient technology point to unlock. == Usage == The Egg Incubator is used to hatch eggs found through out the world or through [[breeding]] at [[Breeding Farm]]. Eggs come in Common, Rocky, Verdant, Damp, Electric, Dragon, Frozen, Dark and Scorching varieties. Each of these is associated with the matching type of Pal. Eggs of each type can also come in Large and Huge varieties which hatch rarer Pals. Placing an [[Pal Eggs|egg]] in the incubator will start a timer. The time it takes to hatch depends on your world settings with Huge eggs taking the longest to hatch. After placing an egg into an incubator, you will be given a short message on the incubator on status. Eggs can be too cold or hot which reduces incubation speed. Placing a [[campfire]], [[heater]], or [[cooler]] next to the incubator (depending on the message displayed on the incubator) will increase incubation speed. Multiple heaters or coolers may be needed for some eggs. ===Time Setting=== The game uses a default value of 72 as a multiplication factor. This value can be adjusted by the user in the configuration files (PalWorldSettings.ini for dedicated servers and in-game settings for single-player). This value represents the total hours (72 hours) required for incubation of a Huge egg at 0%. ===Incubation Time=== Each egg size has a specific base incubation duration, which is calculated using a division factor, referred to here as "Base Time": *Normal Egg: 12 *Large Egg: 2 *Huge Egg: 1 ===Bonus Speed=== The game also allows for varying incubation speeds, each of which has a specific division factor, referred to here as "Incubation Speed". A specific message along with the percentage pops up which are as follows: * 0% (Seems a little cold/hot): 1 *50% (Seems just a little cold/hot): 1.5 * 100% (Seems very comfortable): 2 === Favourable Temperature=== Each egg thrives at a specific temperature! Find the perfect spot where the natural temperature matches the egg's needs, or use any heating or cooling source. The incubator's interface shows the egg's current temperature. Following are the list of all the eggs with their favourable temperature: *'''Cold''' **Damp **Frozen ** Dark *'''Moderate''' **Common **Verdant **Electric *'''Hot''' **Scorching **Rocky **Dragon ===Calculating Incubation Time=== The incubation duration for each egg, given a specific speed, can be determined using the following formula: Incubation Time = \frac{(Configuration Value \times 3600)}{Base Time \times Incubation Speed} This equation yields the total incubation duration in seconds, providing a precise measure of the time required for each egg size at each incubation speed Incubation Time Calculator Google Spreadsheet [https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1_IceCEinC-AnwMq5EWUEVRey_v_wJn5tAb31-I52C0Q https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1WmqrdNoQWYIIaWD8d8ii5g8gz6f7oeb759WQgNWkB_s/] ===Default Incubation Time=== Here are the incubation times using the default configuration value (72): {| class="wikitable" !Egg Size!!Incubation Speed!!Incubation Time!!Incubation Time in Seconds |- | rowspan="3" |Normal |0%||6:00:00||21,600 |- |50%||4:00:00||14400 |- |100%||3:00:00||10800 |- | rowspan="3" |Large |0%||36:00:00||129,600 |- |50%||24:00:00||86,400 |- |100%||18:00:00||64,800 |- | rowspan="3" |Huge |0%||72:00:00||259,200 |- |50%||48:00:00||172,800 |- |100%||36:00:00||129,600 |} ==Update History== *[[Early Access 0.2.1.0]] ** Fixed an issue where [[Pal Eggs|eggs]] could not be placed in the egg incubator if you loaded save data from v0.1.5.x or earlier. *[[Early Access 0.2.0.6]] ** Reduce the button press time in the egg incubator. *[[Early Access 0.1.2.0]] **Introduced.
